appName: Soapbox - Live Performers In Your House
displayName: Soapbox - Live Performers In Your House
display_name: Soapbox - Live Performers In Your House
display_long_description:
Soapbox brings an intimate and up-close next-generation concert experience into your living room with music artists filmed in immersive 360 video. These true-life volumetric videos feature life-size holograms of real-time performances rendered in AR (live in your room) or VR (live in a fully rendered world). Get up close and personal and see your favorite musicians live from every angle. No avatars, no CGI, just the most lifelike music experience ever, only from Soapbox.

Enjoy fully immersive VR experiences from legendary rappers T-Pain and Waka Flocka Flame. We've got incredible live-in-studio performances from Hall of Fame bluesman Buddy Guy, Kevn Kinney from Drivin' N' Cryin', and singer/songwriters Cris Jacobs, Abe Partridge, and John Mark McMillan. We've even got a full band live performance from metal legends Norma Jean. 

There's a special VR experience with R&B singer Tank performing a newly-completed duet with the late R&B legend Aaliyah and a fully immersive world created with the alternative singer/songwriter Eliza Grace.

Soapbox has memorable hip hop performances from Yelawolf, Soulja Boy, Jim Jones, JDot Breezy, WunTayk Timmy, Crime Mob and Dem Franchize Boyz. There's a memorable performance from hip hop artist and OnlyFans creator The Amanda Nicole.

Soapbox is the only way to have your favorite artists appear life-size in your space, performing live in stunning 3D. It's the future of music.
